newsitem.title: USA: US PLAINS CATTLE TRADE THIN AT STEADY $64 - FEEDLOTS.
newsitem.headline: US PLAINS CATTLE TRADE THIN AT STEADY $64 - FEEDLOTS.

text.p: U.S. Plains fed cattle trade Tuesday was light at $64.00 per cwt, unchanged from thin sales on Monday, feedlot sources said.
About 2,000 head were reported sold in Kansas and about 500 in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area after midday, they said.
"I imagine we can still get some cattle traded at $64.00 today, but so far its been pretty light," one Oklahoma feedlot manager said.
Further bids at $64.00 were resisted by owners pricing cattle at $65.00 to mostly $66.00, sources said.
